notes: A white card with the Turkish Airlines Miles&Smiles logo and two fields: Membership Number (with a fixed 'TK' prefix) and Password. A boxed Data Processing Notice says profile information, booking details and search preferences will be transmitted to cloud and AI systems, with a required 'I explicitly consent' checkbox. A Cloudflare 'Verify you are human' widget follows, and the gray submit button reads 'Please Accept Data Processing Consent' until the box is ticked. The footer line says to sign in with the Miles&Smiles account to connect this app. The requesting app is not named and the profile, bookings and flight-search scopes are described only through the data notice.
